newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brokers see CAC-40 index rise towards 3,000 level.
newsitem.headline: Brokers see CAC-40 index rise towards 3,000 level.

text.p: A poll of 16 brokerages conducted by newspaper L'Agefi showed on Monday that the average expectations for the CAC-40 blue-chip index were revised upwards in April.
The poll showed an average in three months of 2,636.33, against an expectation of 2,579.67 last months, while the 12-month forecast went to 2,816.56 from 2,765.00.

NOTE - Poll conducted by l'Agefi newspaper. The paper quoted a market strategist at BZW in Paris as saying that if long term rates in France came down to 5.5 percent, the CAC could hit the 3,000 level. But if rates rose above six percent, he expected a deep correction before a return to 2,700 at the end of the year.
